description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 14.03.2016 to 20.03.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It establishes new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and formally rescinds the previous rates published in an earlier gazette. This content involves regulatory matters and statutory instruments, specifically falling under the "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" category (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements related to customs operations.
